photos.caption: "I DON'T WANT TO BE A BIG STAR, but I do want to be a bloody good actor. That's why I'm behaving like a lunatic." Hence this picture. Cantering in the background is Michael Crawford (soon to be seen with Barbra Streisand in the Hollywood version of "Hello Dolly") who has just been signed to appear in Michael Winner's next film, "The Games," based on the novel by Hugh Atkinson and researcher Phillip Knightley. "The Games" recounts the trials of four Olympic marathon runners and to ensure the authenticity of the athletics in his film, Winner has hired Gordon Pirie as his technical adviser.
